name: std::strstream::~strstream
intro: Destroys a std::strstream object, which also destroys the member std::strstreambuf, which may call the deallocation function if the underlying buffer was dynamically-allocated and not frozen.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If str() was called on a dynamic strstream and freeze(false) was not called after that, this destructor leaks memory.
